payload_digest.description:
SHA-256 over the canonical payload and its kind discriminator
(spec §27.8).

RecordVersionId.description: Stable identity of an immutable record version.

RecordIdentity.description:
The identity of a canonical record (spec §27.1 contract table:
`universe_id`, `record_id`, `record_kind`). Identity and kind are
immutable.

RecordKind.description:

change requires a reviewed migration or a new identity (spec §27.1).

Payload.description:
The closed set of canonical payloads.

The discriminator key is `record_kind` (spec §27.1 contract naming):
several payload structs carry their *own* `kind` field (work, rule,
represented context), so a `kind` discriminator would collide with a
payload field in the canonical object (duplicate key — spec §27.8).

oneOf.description: A canonical entity (spec §5.1, §5.7).

A named world record within a universe (spec §5.6, §36.1).

A world can represent a planet, inhabited domain, simulation, or another
authored setting type. Realms and planets do not automatically become
identical records.

selector.description:
Administrative selector label: the author-facing name (exact display
spelling preserved; §36.2).

aliases.description: Retained aliases (versioned; renames keep the old label — §36.3).

oneOf.description: A realm: an authored physical/metaphysical domain (spec §36.1).

An external narrative work owned by a universe (spec §36.7).

A work can span several worlds; world associations are zero-to-many and
do not establish occurrences, travel, knowledge, or location.

A version of a work with an explicit canon binding (spec §36.7).

Being included in a saga does not select an alternate continuity or
give that work a private head.

binding.description:
The continuity + revision this version depicts, or explicitly
unbound/under review.

oneOf.description:
A scene reference: reader order, narration time, depicted event time,
and local world time stay separate (spec §36.7).

disclosedRecords.description: Explicit reader disclosures; depicted events alone do not establish knowledge.

oneOf.description: A passage reference with a source locator.

A proposition describes something that *may be* asserted; its existence
does not assert its truth.

predicate.description: A property or relation definition record.

roles.description: Named role bindings for n-ary relations.

context.description:
The represented context this proposition lives in (objective

oneOf.description: "The gate is in the ruins" — a particular claim.
"All X have Y".
"Some X has Y".

Assertion.description:
Support or refutation of a proposition in a stated context, time, and
scope (spec §5.2, §27.3).

Approval of the assertion does not erase its context, evidence
limitations, or opposing assertions.

alternatives.description: Alternatives for `one_of` precision (explicit, not a range guess).

establishedBy.description:
Set when this assertion was generated by an admitted event effect

Scope.description:
The scope of an assertion or rule: applicability + represented context
+ optional realm (spec §27.3).

Applicability.description:
Where a fact or rule applies (spec §5.7, §36.5).

Universe ownership alone establishes no applicability: a world selector
is not an implicit authorial assertion about a record's home (I26).

oneOf.description: Explicitly declared true across the whole universe.
Applies to the named worlds (zero is degenerate but legal).
Conditional: applicability is itself evaluated (gap if unresolved).

The author did not specify. An unspecified scope that matters to
validation yields a gap, not a universal rule (V19).

PersistenceSemantics.description:
Declared persistence behavior of a property/assertion (spec §5.5, §7.2).

Weather and fatigue are not carried forward simply because ownership
usually persists.

oneOf.description: Explicit validity interval governs.
True until an explicit change is established.
A single observation at a time; no forward carry.
Depends on a condition (condition-dependent properties).
The author did not declare persistence.

Precision.description:
Explicit precision alternatives (spec §27.2). An estimate is never
silently converted into an exact value or a probability distribution.

EvidenceBasis.description:
Evidence basis for an assertion (spec §27.3).

A content match verifies a citation anchor, not the source's truth.
Verified vs. unverified links are distinct.

oneOf.description: Authorial decision with a note.
Anchor into an immutable source version.

verified.description:
Whether the application has verified the excerpt against the
source version. Agent-provided citations default to unverified.

oneOf.description: Established by an admitted occurred event effect.
Imported from source material; mapping accepted, truth not.

Derived by a named derivation chain (spec §9.4: every inference has
an explicit derivation and evaluator version, or remains an
unverified proposal).

VersionRef.description:
An exact reference to a specific immutable record *version*
(spec §27.1). The two reference kinds are not interchangeable:
record references resolve through the requested snapshot; version
references pin exact immutable evidence.

EventEffectRef.description:
The linkage from an event effect slot to the assertion it established
(spec §27.5).

ItemPower.description:
Explicit dependency: holding this item grants a value while both the
possession evidence and this definition apply. It never changes identity.

ActionDefinition.description:
Author-controlled action vocabulary, including ordinary actions with no
special requirements. Display labels never create executable requirements.

AttributeRequirement.description:
An action's mandatory attribute, resolved on the entity filling this role.
This cannot be replaced by an event's optional prerequisite or another owner.

Event.description:
A canonical event record (spec §7.3, §27.5).

A plan or hypothetical is not an actual occurrence, even when its
existence as a plan is canon (S32).

action.description:
Mandatory on new/revised events. Optional only to decode historical
events without rewriting immutable sources or their payload digests.

sequence.description: Explicit within-event sequencing for ordered effects/phases.

occurrenceId.description:
Occurrence id for repeated events (time loops; S29): recurring
display labels are not unique moments.

preconditions.description: Preconditions are evaluated against the pre-event state.

effects.description: Effects are applied atomically to the candidate post-event state.

expansionVersion.description:
The expansion version the service recorded when it compiled the
effects (spec §27.5).

OccurrenceMode.description:
Event occurrence modes (spec §27.5).

Only an admitted `occurred` event establishes objective state effects
by default. A report establishes a report, not the reported
occurrence.

oneOf.description: Another declared descriptive mode.

EventParticipant.description: An event participant with a named role (spec §7.3).

oneOf.description: Scoped absence of opposing evidence in this exact candidate; never a truth claim.
Authored attitude evidence only; observation/presence never implies knowledge.

internally-tagged newtype representation wraps the serializer in a

to `predicate`/`value` (or `roles` for n-ary relations) with

predicate.description:
Namespaced property or relation key, resolved to a definition
record at compile time (spec §27.2).

context.description:
The represented context of the claim; `None` = the frame's
context.

oneOf.description:
Negation of a state claim: the refutation side of the same evidence.

(spec §9.4). Exact values compare exactly; quantities require
unit-compatible definitions; intervals only when definite.

Temporal relation between two time-bearing operands
(spec §9.4). Indeterminate when the data cannot decide it.

Membership of an element in a finite collection. Refutation of
membership additionally requires the collection to be complete
(spec §9.4).

complete.description:
Whether the collection is declared complete in the frame.
`None` = unknown completeness (negative result is indeterminate).

oneOf.description:
Cardinality of a finite collection (spec §9.4). Negative
conclusions require completeness.

Existence of at least one matching state claim (spec §9.4):
positive evidence only.

Bounded quantification over a collection (spec §9.4, §31.2):
one witness establishes existence even if incomplete; a universal
over an incomplete domain cannot be proved.

Bounded traversal of a declared relationship role (spec §9.4).
The traversed record is bound as the result of this node for
composition (used inside larger expressions via variables in
practice; the node itself is a structural check that the relation
holds).

Operand.description: An operand of an expression node.

oneOf.description: A variable bound by the rule scope or a quantifier.

Struct variants keep one canonical form per operand: the referenced
record/value is nested under a named key, never inlined into the
tagged map (see `Canonical for Operand` below).
The frame's current time (a temporal operand).
A participant of the candidate event, by role.
The occurrence of the candidate event itself.

EpistemicAttitudeKind.description:
Epistemic attitudes (spec §27.6): `believes`, `suspects`, `rejects`,
`remembers`, and authored knowledge stay distinct. Do not silently
promote a belief.

Comparator.description: Three-way comparator for numeric and exact comparisons.

Quantifier.description: A named binding in an expression environment.

EntityEffect.description:
An authored effect: compiled into explicit assertion operations in the
same immutable proposal revision (spec §27.5).

The effect's assertion operations — not a second mutable state object —
are the canonical state representation.

slot.description: Explicit effect slot id; the generated assertion records it.

proposition.description:
The proposition the effect establishes (a local reference is
resolved to a new proposition record during compilation).

order.description:
Noncommuting effects on the same resource need an authored order
(spec §27.5): explicit when necessary.

Observation.description:
An observation: presence alone does not establish perception or
understanding (spec §27.6).

Communication.description:
A communication: knowledge changes need receipt and the declared
acquisition/interpretation basis (spec §27.6).

Memory.description:
A memory: remembered content can be false, incomplete, or detached
from objective events (spec §27.6).

Goal.description:
A goal/plan: an approved plan does not execute itself or reserve
resources automatically (spec §27.6).

Commitment.description:
A commitment: violations are permitted occurrences; prescribed
consequences happen only when established (spec §27.6).

EntityType.description:
An entity type. Multiple types are permitted; inheritance cycles for
executable subtype traversal are rejected at compile time.

classificationExecutable.description: Whether subtype traversal may be used by executable rules.

PropertyDef.description:
A property definition (spec §27.2).

Inverse, symmetric, transitive, or exclusive behavior is opt-in; no
implicit behavior from the display label.

subjectTypes.description: Allowed subject type ids.

exclusive.description:
Exclusive: at most one value holder per subject at a time
(opt-in — spec §5.5).

ValueShape.description: The typed shape of a property value (spec §27.2).

oneOf.description: No declared shape (descriptive).

RelationDef.description: A relation definition: n-ary participant assignments (spec §5.1).

RoleDef.description:
A named role in a relation (spec §27.2): supports more than two roles
and more than one participant per role where declared.

UnitDef.description:
A unit definition (spec §27.2): conversion must be defined and
compatible; unknown exchange rates remain unresolved.

scaleToBase.description: Exact scale to a declared base unit.

CalendarDef.description:
A calendar / temporal reference system (spec §27.2).

A label-only calendar is storable but cannot support invented
arithmetic (S30): `conversions` empty → unsupported capability.

conversions.description: Authored conversion relationships to other calendars.

expression.description:
Authored conversion expression; empty/unsupported → `unsupported`
capability, never invented arithmetic.

ValueDef.description:
A structured value definition (spec §27.2): no executable field
expressions, arbitrary SQL, or unbounded recursive schemas.

allowsUnknown.description:
Explicitly permitted unknown alternative (optional data has
explicit states — spec §5.3).

applicability.description:
Where the rule applies (universe-wide / worlds / conditional /
unspecified).

capabilities.description:

unsupported ones (spec §27.10).

validity.description: Temporal validity of the rule itself (S35: jurisdictional scoping).

FindingFingerprint.description:
A finding fingerprint: rule version, candidate digest, relevant fact and
source versions, temporal/context scope, and issue category (spec §31.7).

A resolution applies to the exact fingerprint/scope; the same wording
with changed evidence or rule produces a new fingerprint (E24).

RecordVersionId.description: Stable identity of an immutable record version.

Proposition.description:
A claimable statement (spec §5.2, §27.3).

A proposition describes something that *may be* asserted; its existence
does not assert its truth.

predicate.description: A property or relation definition record.

roles.description: Named role bindings for n-ary relations.

context.description:
The represented context this proposition lives in (objective
reality, a character's beliefs, a source narrative, ...).

oneOf.description: "The gate is in the ruins" — a particular claim.
"All X have Y".
"Some X has Y".

VersionRef.description:
An exact reference to a specific immutable record *version*
(spec §27.1). The two reference kinds are not interchangeable:
record references resolve through the requested snapshot; version
references pin exact immutable evidence.

Applicability.description:
Where a fact or rule applies (spec §5.7, §36.5).

Universe ownership alone establishes no applicability: a world selector
is not an implicit authorial assertion about a record's home (I26).

oneOf.description: Explicitly declared true across the whole universe.
Applies to the named worlds (zero is degenerate but legal).
Conditional: applicability is itself evaluated (gap if unresolved).

The author did not specify. An unspecified scope that matters to
validation yields a gap, not a universal rule (V19).

Validity.description:
Fictional-time validity of an assertion (spec §7.2).

An omitted/`Unknown` boundary is not automatically negative or positive
infinity (spec §5.3). Intervals are half-open `[start, end)` where
exact interval algebra applies (S26).

oneOf.description: No temporal claim was made. Distinct from `Unknown`.
The author has not established when.
True at exactly one (approximate or exact) time.
Half-open interval `[start, end)` for exact endpoints.

Half-open validity on an explicitly authored clock. Legacy intervals
without a clock remain unresolved for time-specific queries.
Persistent from `from` until an explicit change is established.
Truth depends on an authored condition.

AssessmentVersionRef.description: Exact workflow evidence references use the existing domain wire keys and IDs.

Sha256Hex.description: Owning decoder enforces the same exact digest shape as the JSON schema.

AssessmentState.description:
Approved reporting states. The current service produces only absent and
unavailable_legacy; future bound states require recorded assessment evidence.

compiled_changes.description: Exact compiled expansion for proposal retrieval. Paged with the authored operations.

DomainOperation.description:
The versioned domain operation catalog underlying proposal batches
(spec §27.9). Each operation carries a closed typed payload and, for
replacement, the exact expected prior version.

oneOf.description: Adopt an existing immutable historical version through exact review.

ContextualName.description:
A contextual name (spec §5.4): language, community, time, optional
role. Original Unicode spelling preserved; a separate normalized search
form is maintained by the service (normalization helps search, not
identity).

WorldAssociation.description:
A world association with optional qualifiers (spec §5.7, §36.7):
changing associations and changing physical location are separate
operations.

World.description:
A named world record within a universe (spec §5.6, §36.1).

A world can represent a planet, inhabited domain, simulation, or another
authored setting type. Realms and planets do not automatically become
identical records.

selector.description:
Administrative selector label: the author-facing name (exact display
spelling preserved; §36.2).

aliases.description: Retained aliases (versioned; renames keep the old label — §36.3).

Work.description:
An external narrative work owned by a universe (spec §36.7).

A work can span several worlds; world associations are zero-to-many and
do not establish occurrences, travel, knowledge, or location.

WorkKind.description:
Narrative work kinds (spec §5.6): a work is universe-owned metadata,
never a manuscript store.

oneOf.description:
Another declared kind: authors use the work's labels/metadata for
the specific kind, not an untyped escape hatch.

Saga.description:
A saga/series: typed membership and ordering, non-exclusive (spec §5.6,
§36.7).

oneOf.description: Bound to an explicit continuity/revision.
Explicitly unbound / under review.

Depicts several continuities: segment-level bindings instead of
merging contradictory facts.

Assertion.description:
Support or refutation of a proposition in a stated context, time, and
scope (spec §5.2, §27.3).

Approval of the assertion does not erase its context, evidence
limitations, or opposing assertions.

alternatives.description: Alternatives for `one_of` precision (explicit, not a range guess).

establishedBy.description:
Set when this assertion was generated by an admitted event effect
(spec §27.5: the compiled assertion is the canonical state
representation; the linkage is structurally checked).

Polarity.description: Support or refutation of a proposition (spec §5.2).

Scope.description:
The scope of an assertion or rule: applicability + represented context
+ optional realm (spec §27.3).

context.description:
The represented context record (objective reality, a character,
a source narrative, ...). Required: every assertion states its
context explicitly.

PersistenceSemantics.description:
Declared persistence behavior of a property/assertion (spec §5.5, §7.2).

Weather and fatigue are not carried forward simply because ownership
usually persists.

oneOf.description: Explicit validity interval governs.
True until an explicit change is established.
A single observation at a time; no forward carry.
Depends on a condition (condition-dependent properties).
The author did not declare persistence.

Precision.description:
Explicit precision alternatives (spec §27.2). An estimate is never
silently converted into an exact value or a probability distribution.

EvidenceBasis.description:
Evidence basis for an assertion (spec §27.3).

A content match verifies a citation anchor, not the source's truth.
Verified vs. unverified links are distinct.

oneOf.description: Authorial decision with a note.
Anchor into an immutable source version.

verified.description:
Whether the application has verified the excerpt against the
source version. Agent-provided citations default to unverified.

oneOf.description: Established by an admitted occurred event effect.
Imported from source material; mapping accepted, truth not.

Derived by a named derivation chain (spec §9.4: every inference has
an explicit derivation and evaluator version, or remains an
unverified proposal).

EventEffectRef.description:
The linkage from an event effect slot to the assertion it established
(spec §27.5).

ItemPower.description:
Explicit dependency: holding this item grants a value while both the
possession evidence and this definition apply. It never changes identity.

ActionDefinition.description:
Author-controlled action vocabulary, including ordinary actions with no
special requirements. Display labels never create executable requirements.

AttributeRequirement.description:
An action's mandatory attribute, resolved on the entity filling this role.
This cannot be replaced by an event's optional prerequisite or another owner.

Event.description:
A canonical event record (spec §7.3, §27.5).

A plan or hypothetical is not an actual occurrence, even when its
existence as a plan is canon (S32).

action.description:
Mandatory on new/revised events. Optional only to decode historical
events without rewriting immutable sources or their payload digests.

sequence.description: Explicit within-event sequencing for ordered effects/phases.

occurrenceId.description:
Occurrence id for repeated events (time loops; S29): recurring
display labels are not unique moments.

preconditions.description: Preconditions are evaluated against the pre-event state.

effects.description: Effects are applied atomically to the candidate post-event state.

expansionVersion.description:
The expansion version the service recorded when it compiled the
effects (spec §27.5).

OccurrenceMode.description:
Event occurrence modes (spec §27.5).

Only an admitted `occurred` event establishes objective state effects
by default. A report establishes a report, not the reported
occurrence.

oneOf.description: Another declared descriptive mode.

EventParticipant.description: An event participant with a named role (spec §7.3).

oneOf.description: Scoped absence of opposing evidence in this exact candidate; never a truth claim.
Authored attitude evidence only; observation/presence never implies knowledge.

`true` / `false` literals (boolean composition — spec §9.4).

Struct variants (not newtype) for all boolean forms: serde's
internally-tagged newtype representation wraps the serializer in a
new `TaggedSerializer` per recursion level (recursion limit), and
would emit a duplicate `kind` key when the content is itself tagged.
Field names match the canonical impl below.
All children must hold (`and` with unknown/conflict propagation).
At least one child holds (`or`).

A claim about the state in the current frame: is `subject` related
to `predicate`/`value` (or `roles` for n-ary relations) with
`polarity` in `context`? Evaluates to the two evidence bits.

predicate.description:
Namespaced property or relation key, resolved to a definition
record at compile time (spec §27.2).

context.description:
The represented context of the claim; `None` = the frame's
context.

oneOf.description:
Negation of a state claim: the refutation side of the same evidence.
(Provided for rule authoring convenience; `Not(claim)` is equivalent.)

Equality/inequality of two operands with defined comparisons
(spec §9.4). Exact values compare exactly; quantities require
unit-compatible definitions; intervals only when definite.

Temporal relation between two time-bearing operands
(spec §9.4). Indeterminate when the data cannot decide it.

Membership of an element in a finite collection. Refutation of
membership additionally requires the collection to be complete
(spec §9.4).

complete.description:
Whether the collection is declared complete in the frame.
`None` = unknown completeness (negative result is indeterminate).

oneOf.description:
Cardinality of a finite collection (spec §9.4). Negative
conclusions require completeness.

Existence of at least one matching state claim (spec §9.4):
positive evidence only.

Bounded quantification over a collection (spec §9.4, §31.2):
one witness establishes existence even if incomplete; a universal
over an incomplete domain cannot be proved.

Bounded traversal of a declared relationship role (spec §9.4).
The traversed record is bound as the result of this node for
composition (used inside larger expressions via variables in
practice; the node itself is a structural check that the relation
holds).

Operand.description: An operand of an expression node.

oneOf.description: A variable bound by the rule scope or a quantifier.

Struct variants keep one canonical form per operand: the referenced
record/value is nested under a named key, never inlined into the
tagged map (see `Canonical for Operand` below).
The frame's current time (a temporal operand).
A participant of the candidate event, by role.
The occurrence of the candidate event itself.

EpistemicAttitudeKind.description:
Epistemic attitudes (spec §27.6): `believes`, `suspects`, `rejects`,
`remembers`, and authored knowledge stay distinct. Do not silently
promote a belief.

Comparator.description: Three-way comparator for numeric and exact comparisons.

Quantifier.description: A named binding in an expression environment.

EntityEffect.description:
An authored effect: compiled into explicit assertion operations in the
same immutable proposal revision (spec §27.5).

The effect's assertion operations — not a second mutable state object —
are the canonical state representation.

slot.description: Explicit effect slot id; the generated assertion records it.

proposition.description:

Only an admitted `occurred` event establishes objective state effects
by default. A report establishes a report, not the reported
occurrence.

oneOf.description: Another declared descriptive mode.

EventParticipant.description: An event participant with a named role (spec §7.3).

oneOf.description: Scoped absence of opposing evidence in this exact candidate; never a truth claim.
Authored attitude evidence only; observation/presence never implies knowledge.

`true` / `false` literals (boolean composition — spec §9.4).

Struct variants (not newtype) for all boolean forms: serde's
internally-tagged newtype representation wraps the serializer in a
new `TaggedSerializer` per recursion level (recursion limit), and
would emit a duplicate `kind` key when the content is itself tagged.
Field names match the canonical impl below.
All children must hold (`and` with unknown/conflict propagation).
At least one child holds (`or`).

A claim about the state in the current frame: is `subject` related
to `predicate`/`value` (or `roles` for n-ary relations) with
`polarity` in `context`? Evaluates to the two evidence bits.

predicate.description:
Namespaced property or relation key, resolved to a definition
record at compile time (spec §27.2).

context.description:
The represented context of the claim; `None` = the frame's
context.

oneOf.description:
Negation of a state claim: the refutation side of the same evidence.
(Provided for rule authoring convenience; `Not(claim)` is equivalent.)

Equality/inequality of two operands with defined comparisons
(spec §9.4). Exact values compare exactly; quantities require
unit-compatible definitions; intervals only when definite.

Temporal relation between two time-bearing operands
(spec §9.4). Indeterminate when the data cannot decide it.

Membership of an element in a finite collection. Refutation of
membership additionally requires the collection to be complete
(spec §9.4).

complete.description:
Whether the collection is declared complete in the frame.
`None` = unknown completeness (negative result is indeterminate).

oneOf.description:
Cardinality of a finite collection (spec §9.4). Negative
conclusions require completeness.

Existence of at least one matching state claim (spec §9.4):
positive evidence only.

Bounded quantification over a collection (spec §9.4, §31.2):
one witness establishes existence even if incomplete; a universal
over an incomplete domain cannot be proved.

Bounded traversal of a declared relationship role (spec §9.4).
The traversed record is bound as the result of this node for
composition (used inside larger expressions via variables in
practice; the node itself is a structural check that the relation
holds).

Operand.description: An operand of an expression node.

oneOf.description: A variable bound by the rule scope or a quantifier.

Struct variants keep one canonical form per operand: the referenced
record/value is nested under a named key, never inlined into the
tagged map (see `Canonical for Operand` below).
The frame's current time (a temporal operand).
A participant of the candidate event, by role.
The occurrence of the candidate event itself.

EpistemicAttitudeKind.description:
Epistemic attitudes (spec §27.6): `believes`, `suspects`, `rejects`,
`remembers`, and authored knowledge stay distinct. Do not silently
promote a belief.

Comparator.description: Three-way comparator for numeric and exact comparisons.

Quantifier.description: A named binding in an expression environment.

EntityEffect.description:
An authored effect: compiled into explicit assertion operations in the
same immutable proposal revision (spec §27.5).

The effect's assertion operations — not a second mutable state object —
are the canonical state representation.

slot.description: Explicit effect slot id; the generated assertion records it.

proposition.description:
The proposition the effect establishes (a local reference is
resolved to a new proposition record during compilation).

order.description:
Noncommuting effects on the same resource need an authored order
(spec §27.5): explicit when necessary.

Observation.description:
An observation: presence alone does not establish perception or
understanding (spec §27.6).

Communication.description:
A communication: knowledge changes need receipt and the declared
acquisition/interpretation basis (spec §27.6).

Memory.description:
A memory: remembered content can be false, incomplete, or detached
from objective events (spec §27.6).

Goal.description:
A goal/plan: an approved plan does not execute itself or reserve
resources automatically (spec §27.6).

Commitment.description:
A commitment: violations are permitted occurrences; prescribed
consequences happen only when established (spec §27.6).

EntityType.description:
An entity type. Multiple types are permitted; inheritance cycles for
executable subtype traversal are rejected at compile time.

classificationExecutable.description: Whether subtype traversal may be used by executable rules.

PropertyDef.description:
A property definition (spec §27.2).

Inverse, symmetric, transitive, or exclusive behavior is opt-in; no
implicit behavior from the display label.

subjectTypes.description: Allowed subject type ids.

exclusive.description:
Exclusive: at most one value holder per subject at a time
(opt-in — spec §5.5).

ValueShape.description: The typed shape of a property value (spec §27.2).

oneOf.description: No declared shape (descriptive).

RelationDef.description: A relation definition: n-ary participant assignments (spec §5.1).

RoleDef.description:
A named role in a relation (spec §27.2): supports more than two roles
and more than one participant per role where declared.

UnitDef.description:
A unit definition (spec §27.2): conversion must be defined and
compatible; unknown exchange rates remain unresolved.

scaleToBase.description: Exact scale to a declared base unit.

CalendarDef.description:
A calendar / temporal reference system (spec §27.2).

A label-only calendar is storable but cannot support invented
arithmetic (S30): `conversions` empty → unsupported capability.

conversions.description: Authored conversion relationships to other calendars.

expression.description:
Authored conversion expression; empty/unsupported → `unsupported`
capability, never invented arithmetic.

ValueDef.description:
A structured value definition (spec §27.2): no executable field
expressions, arbitrary SQL, or unbounded recursive schemas.

allowsUnknown.description:
Explicitly permitted unknown alternative (optional data has
explicit states — spec §5.3).

applicability.description:
Where the rule applies (universe-wide / worlds / conditional /
unspecified).

subjectTypes.description: Subject types the rule constrains (empty = any).

capabilities.description:
Evaluator capabilities required; an unevaluable rule lists
unsupported ones (spec §27.10).

executable.description: Whether the evaluator can execute this rule (set at compile time).

validity.description: Temporal validity of the rule itself (S35: jurisdictional scoping).

RuleKind.description:
Rule kinds with distinct semantics and commit policies (spec §9.3).

Severity, commit-blocking policy, and semantic type are distinct.

oneOf.description: Invalid record shape: always blocks commit; no author waiver.

Cannot occur under established rules: blocks delegated commit
unless a valid scoped exception or authorized revision resolves it.
A specified action requires defined prerequisites.

Actors may violate it: a normative departure, not physical
impossibility.
Typical rather than universal behavior: advisory only.

Controls permitted additions/revisions: enforced by scope and
authorization.
Stored but not executable by this evaluator.

CommitPolicy.description: How a rule's finding affects a commit (spec §9.3).

oneOf.description: Always blocks (structural integrity; no author waiver).

Blocks delegated commit unless a valid scoped exception or an
authorized canon revision resolves it.
Records a finding; commit proceeds (law/normative).
Advisory: surfaced, never blocks.
Enforced through scope/authorization rather than evaluation.
Reported as unsupported coverage (descriptive/unevaluable).

CompletenessDecl.description:
A scoped completeness declaration (spec §8.2, §27.3).

A complete empty sibling set establishes no siblings in its scope; an
empty search result does not. A list complete for one room does not
cover an entire building. Completeness for an observer's known set is
not completeness for objective reality.

predicate.description: The collection predicate whose membership is declared.

members.description: Exact complete membership (empty = explicitly empty set).

completeness.description: Completeness of objective reality vs. an observer's known set.

EntityIdAlias.description:
An entity identified by its record id (alias for readability; entities
are records — spec §5.1: a ship that is also an individual does not
require duplicate identities).

CreativeBoundary.description: An authorial creative boundary over a named area (spec §8.4).

area.description: The area: a record or a predicate/subject pattern.

constraints.description: Constraints that apply when the mode allows material.

oneOf.description:
A canonical record reference with an explicit universe namespace
(spec §27.1). The namespace may be omitted in *wire* input where the
required `universe` argument supplies it; the service expands and rejects
conflicting namespaces before storage. Canonical payloads always carry it.

universe.description: Universe namespace. `None` only in wire input pending expansion.

record.description:
Stable record identity (resolved through the requested revision's
membership map — spec §27.1).

oneOf.description: A whole category (e.g. all entities of a type).
The area is fixed: new material is not allowed.
Open, but within constraints (the constraints are evaluated).

The default for undefined areas: proposals required, no automatic
permission to invent (spec §8.4).
Reserved for the author's own discretion.

Intentionally unresolved (I20): usable data without an invented
answer.
New material is prohibited.

Exception.description: A scoped exception to a rule (spec §9.3, §31.3).

scope.description: The exact affected scope of the exception.

authorizingDecision.description: The author decision that authorized this exception.

Anchor.description:
An evidence anchor into an immutable source version (spec §14.1, §27.7).

Byte boundaries must align to decoded character boundaries.

oneOf.description: UTF-8 byte offsets in the declared decoded-text representation.
Structural path (document sections).

RecordKind.description:
The kind of a canonical record. Identity and kind are immutable: a kind
change requires a reviewed migration or a new identity (spec §27.1).

Payload.description:
The closed set of canonical payloads.

The discriminator key is `record_kind` (spec §27.1 contract naming):
several payload structs carry their *own* `kind` field (work, rule,
represented context), so a `kind` discriminator would collide with a
payload field in the canonical object (duplicate key — spec §27.8).

oneOf.description: A canonical entity (spec §5.1, §5.7).

A named world record within a universe (spec §5.6, §36.1).

A world can represent a planet, inhabited domain, simulation, or another
authored setting type. Realms and planets do not automatically become
identical records.

selector.description:
Administrative selector label: the author-facing name (exact display
spelling preserved; §36.2).

aliases.description: Retained aliases (versioned; renames keep the old label — §36.3).

oneOf.description: A realm: an authored physical/metaphysical domain (spec §36.1).

An external narrative work owned by a universe (spec §36.7).

A work can span several worlds; world associations are zero-to-many and
do not establish occurrences, travel, knowledge, or location.

A version of a work with an explicit canon binding (spec §36.7).

Being included in a saga does not select an alternate continuity or
give that work a private head.

binding.description:
The continuity + revision this version depicts, or explicitly
unbound/under review.

oneOf.description:
A scene reference: reader order, narration time, depicted event time,
and local world time stay separate (spec §36.7).

disclosedRecords.description: Explicit reader disclosures; depicted events alone do not establish knowledge.

oneOf.description: A passage reference with a source locator.

A saga/series: typed membership and ordering, non-exclusive (spec §5.6,
§36.7).

An entity type. Multiple types are permitted; inheritance cycles for
executable subtype traversal are rejected at compile time.

classificationExecutable.description: Whether subtype traversal may be used by executable rules.

A structured value definition (spec §27.2): no executable field

capabilities.description:
Evaluator capabilities this pack declares (spec §27.10): a newly
installed pack cannot declare the application capable of evaluating
code that has not been implemented — the registry cross-checks.

records.description: Record ids contributed by this pack.

oneOf.description:
A claimable statement (spec §5.2, §27.3).

A proposition describes something that *may be* asserted; its existence
does not assert its truth.

predicate.description: A property or relation definition record.

roles.description: Named role bindings for n-ary relations.

context.description:
The represented context this proposition lives in (objective
reality, a character's beliefs, a source narrative, ...).

oneOf.description:
Support or refutation of a proposition in a stated context, time, and
scope (spec §5.2, §27.3).

Approval of the assertion does not erase its context, evidence
limitations, or opposing assertions.

alternatives.description: Alternatives for `one_of` precision (explicit, not a range guess).

establishedBy.description:
Set when this assertion was generated by an admitted event effect
(spec §27.5: the compiled assertion is the canonical state
representation; the linkage is structurally checked).

members.description: Exact complete membership (empty = explicitly empty set).

constraints.description: Constraints that apply when the mode allows material.

applicability.description:
Where the rule applies (universe-wide / worlds / conditional /

subjectTypes.description: Subject types the rule constrains (empty = any).

Evaluator capabilities required; an unevaluable rule lists

executable.description: Whether the evaluator can execute this rule (set at compile time).

scope.description: The exact affected scope of the exception.

authorizingDecision.description: The author decision that authorized this exception.

oneOf.description:
A canonical event record (spec §7.3, §27.5).

A plan or hypothetical is not an actual occurrence, even when its
existence as a plan is canon (S32).

action.description:
Mandatory on new/revised events. Optional only to decode historical
events without rewriting immutable sources or their payload digests.

sequence.description: Explicit within-event sequencing for ordered effects/phases.

occurrenceId.description:
Occurrence id for repeated events (time loops; S29): recurring
display labels are not unique moments.

preconditions.description: Preconditions are evaluated against the pre-event state.

effects.description: Effects are applied atomically to the candidate post-event state.

expansionVersion.description:
The expansion version the service recorded when it compiled the
effects (spec §27.5).

oneOf.description:
Explicit dependency: holding this item grants a value while both the
possession evidence and this definition apply. It never changes identity.

Author-controlled action vocabulary, including ordinary actions with no
special requirements. Display labels never create executable requirements.

understanding (spec §27.6).

A communication: knowledge changes need receipt and the declared
acquisition/interpretation basis (spec §27.6).

A memory: remembered content can be false, incomplete, or detached
from objective events (spec §27.6).

Fictional secrecy and application access grants remain separate.

externalId.description: External identifier (an identifier, not a fetch — spec §13.1).

oneOf.description: An immutable source version (spec §14.1, §27.7).

importTime.description: Editorial time (RFC3339 UTC) — never a fictional time.

An evidence anchor into an immutable source version (spec §14.1, §27.7).

Byte boundaries must align to decoded character boundaries.

An author decision on a finding (spec §10.6, §31.7).

A resolution names the particular finding fingerprint and scope; it
must not suppress a materially different future problem.

RepresentedContextKind.description:
A represented context (spec §27.3): a dream, myth, quotation, or
embedded story is not automatically objective reality.

oneOf.description: The objective reality of this universe.
A character's represented beliefs/knowledge.
A source's depicted narrative.
A narrator's account.
Another authored context (dream, myth, embedded story).

first_interaction.description: Immutable first interaction coordinate in this authored clock.

current.description: Revision-bound current coordinate; only an explicit operation changes it.

OriginMetadata.description: Origin metadata for a source or source version (spec §14.1).

PrincipalId.description: Stable identity of an authenticated application principal.

DecodingDescriptor.description:
The decoding descriptor of a text source version (spec §27.7):
canonical text offsets are UTF-8 byte offsets in this named
representation.

oneOf.description: Explicitly accept a scoped unresolved issue/inconsistency (I20).
Defer: keep the finding open.
Resolve: the issue is closed in the named scope.

IssueDecision.description:
An author decision on a finding (spec §10.6, §31.7).

A resolution names the particular finding fingerprint and scope; it
must not suppress a materially different future problem.

RecordVersion.description:
An immutable typed record version (spec §27.1 contract table:
`record_version_id`, identity, `payload_schema_version`, typed
`payload`, `payload_digest`).

Content is immutable; actor/time/decision attribution is linked through
the editorial commit that admitted it (spec §27.1).

payload_digest.description:
SHA-256 over the canonical payload and its kind discriminator
(spec §27.8).

RecordIdentity.description:
The identity of a canonical record (spec §27.1 contract table:
`universe_id`, `record_id`, `record_kind`). Identity and kind are
immutable.

PayloadDigest.description:
SHA-256 digest of the canonical serialized payload and its schema
discriminator (spec §27.8).

DomainPack.description: A domain pack: data, not code (spec §16, §27.2).

installed pack cannot declare the application capable of evaluating
